title: Fable
shortDescription: Peter Molyneux's Albion epic where player actions dynamically transform your Hero into an angel or a horned demon.
historicalSignificance: Pioneered visible physical character aging, moral reputation, and whimsical British fairy tale role-playing on Xbox.

sourceReferences: Video Game History Foundation Preservation Archive
